name: Andrew Cowie
story: Andrew Cowie co-authored “Current status and future directions of mobile GIS” for SIRC NZ in 2013, with David Medyckyj-Scott and fellow contributors. Otago’s repository records the paper under mobile devices, location-based services and open-source GIS.
GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Andrew Cowie as an author of “Web mapping and scientific data at Landcare Research”.
Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Andrew Cowie as an author of “Spatio-temporal web mapping of scientific data”.
